title: Sulphur Banks Caution Sign, 1949 Hawaii Geothermal B&W Snapshot Photo
location: Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, Hawaii, United States
description: A close-up black-and-white snapshot capturing a rustic carved wooden warning sign that reads 'SULPHUR BANKS = CAUTION - ACIDS = PLEASE KEEP OFF' in a rugged, rocky volcanic landscape. The Sulphur Banks (Haʻakulamanu) are a prominent geothermal feature in Hawaii Volcanoes National Park on the island of Hawaii. The photo was taken in May 1949 during a trip to the volcanic park.
